name: Next Steps Commitment Canvas
deliverable: Explicit contractual agreement covering resources, cadence, and sign-offs

steps.text: Frame the canvas as a delivery charter: what the room signs today is what the team will be held to once the workshop ends.
Fill the sections together: scope, resources, review cadence, and the risks that could break the commitment.
Write the definition of done as a check that can pass or fail, not as an activity someone will keep working on.
Read the charter back, have each core member sign, and publish it where the team already looks for decisions.

failure: Hidden resource starvation: the team signs an ambitious scope while every hour is already promised to support work, so the charter is a promise no one can keep.
intervention: Before the signing, ask what each person will deprioritize to make room. If nothing is named, cut the scope until something is.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A workshop charter format in wide use; no single documented originator.
